sources.entry: hacker-menu - Hacker News Delivered to Desktop.

summary.one_liner: Hacker Menu is an Electron and Node.js menu bar app that shows top stories from the Y Combinator news aggregator (Hacker News).
summary.what_it_does: The app sits in the macOS menu bar and delivers the top news stories from the Y Combinator news aggregator. The README says it is powered by Electron and Node.js. It is installed from a prebuilt release download rather than from a package manager. Developers can run it from source with npm install and npm start, which launches it inside the Electron wrapper. Other npm tasks cover tests, building, watching for changes, packaging the Mac app, and a release step that zips the app and needs a signing certificate.
use_cases: read Hacker News from the menu bar
keep up with top tech news on desktop
run a Hacker News desktop reader
learn how to build a menu bar app with Electron
how_to_run: Download the latest build for your platform from the releases page (OSX build only per README)
notable: Lives in the macOS menu bar and shows top Hacker News stories
Includes npm scripts to package and zip a signed Mac app
caveats: Only an OSX build is available; Windows and Linux builds are described as in progress
The release packaging step requires a code signing certificate
Roadmap is tracked only through the issues page
